title: Checkout API returning 503 under load
description: Orders failed with 503 and requests stalled around 30s. Application threads were waiting for a database connection while the database itself was idle.
root_cause: Connection pool maximum size was set too low after a config change; all connections busy and requests queued.
resolution: Raised the pool size, restarted pods to clear stuck connections.

title: Reporting job starves app of database connections
description: A long running report query held many connections. Web requests timed out waiting to borrow a connection from the pool.
root_cause: Leaked connections from a new query that never closed result sets, exhausting the pool.
resolution: Fixed the leak, restarted service, increased pool temporarily.

title: Payments returning 500 after new version
description: Spike of HTTP 500 and pod restarts immediately after a release. Stack traces showed a null pointer in new code path.
root_cause: Regression introduced by the latest release; missing null check in new feature code.
resolution: Rolled back to the previous version, fix shipped next day.

title: Login service crash looping after rollout
description: Pods restarted continuously and error rate climbed minutes after a deployment. Logs showed unhandled exceptions on startup.
root_cause: Bad configuration and code change in latest release caused unhandled exception on startup.

title: Session store overloaded, carts empty
description: Cache latency jumped, keys were evicted and users lost cart contents. Memory of the in-memory store was full.
root_cause: Redis hit maxmemory because TTLs were missing on new keys, causing evictions and OOM errors.
resolution: Flushed stale keys, added TTLs, scaled up the cache node.

title: Recommendation cache timeouts
description: Reads from the key-value cache timed out intermittently and miss ratio rose sharply. Cache memory usage near 100 percent.
root_cause: Cache memory exhausted by oversized values, leading to evictions and slow commands.
resolution: Scaled cache memory and flushed oversized keys.

title: Shipping rates call hanging
description: Checkout steps timed out when calling an external partner API. Our services were healthy but the partner responded with gateway timeouts.
root_cause: Third party provider outage causing very high latency and 504 responses.
resolution: Enabled circuit breaker with cached fallback rates until provider recovered.

title: Address verification vendor slow
description: Signup flow stalled calling an external verification vendor. Read timeouts to the vendor, no internal changes.
root_cause: External vendor degraded; no timeout or fallback protection on our side.
resolution: Enabled circuit breaker and shorter timeouts.

title: Mobile app cannot connect securely
description: Clients failed to establish encrypted connections to the API gateway. Handshake errors started exactly at midnight.
root_cause: The TLS certificate expired because auto renewal job had silently failed.
resolution: Issued and installed a new certificate, fixed renewal job.

title: Partner webhook TLS failures
description: Partner systems rejected our endpoint with trust errors. Server process was healthy but secure connections failed.
root_cause: Expired intermediate certificate in the served chain.
